user.title: East London Mosque Adhan
user.description: Adds East London Mosque's prayer timetable (London Unified Prayer Times, from the mosque's website) and its live Mixlr adhan stream: the current prayer, the next time of each prayer, the Islamic date, the stream URL, and whether the mosque is on air.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Mixlr. Check your internet connection and try again.

abort.already_configured: East London Mosque Adhan is already set up.
abort.single_instance_allowed: East London Mosque Adhan is already set up.

data.islamic_date_at_maghrib: Start the Islamic day at Maghrib

data_description.asr_mithl: The timetable lists two Asr times. Hanafi practice uses the second (2 mithl).
data_description.islamic_date_at_maghrib: The Islamic day begins at sunset. Turn off to change the Islamic date at midnight instead.
data_description.scan_interval: How often to check Mixlr, in minutes. The blueprint forces a refresh at prayer time, so a longer interval is fine.

timetable_expiring.title: East London Mosque timetable is running out
timetable_expiring.description: The stored prayer timetable ends on {last_day}, and the mosque's website ({url}) has not published later dates yet. The prayer entities become unknown after that day. This clears itself once the new timetable is published.
